privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how your personal data is processed when you book an appointment through this site.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: The clinic you are booking with is the data controller responsible for your personal data. Its full identity and contact details are provided by the clinic.

dataProcessed.title: What data we process
dataProcessed.body: We process the data you provide to book a visit: your first name, last name, phone number, email address, and any short note you add. We also store appointment dates and their status.

purpose.title: Why we process it
purpose.body: Your data is used to schedule, confirm, manage, and cancel your appointment, and to contact you about it.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.body: We process your data based on your consent and to take steps to provide the service you request. You can withdraw consent at any time, which does not affect processing already carried out.

recipients.title: Who can see your data
recipients.body: Your data is accessible to the clinic's staff. It may be processed by technical service providers (such as hosting and email delivery) acting on the clinic's behalf. We do not sell your data.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep your data for as long as needed to manage your care relationship and to meet legal obligations. After a defined period of inactivity, your contact details are anonymized.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, correct, delete, and receive a copy of your data, and to object to or restrict its processing. To exercise these rights, contact the clinic.

voluntary.title: Is providing data required
voluntary.body: Providing your contact details is necessary to book and manage an appointment. The optional note is voluntary; please do not include sensitive medical details.

security.title: Security
security.body: We use appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data. Cancellation links are stored only as hashes, and sensitive actions are logged.

privacy.contactNotice: The clinic provides its full identity, contact details, and any supervisory authority information in line with applicable law.
